description: Transactional email via the Mailgun HTTP API (MAILGUN_API_BASE picks the region; empty = US). Implementation stays in notifications/mailgun.py, wrapped in place like otp_send.py for waha/meta. The installation default: nothing configured keeps sending through Mailgun. Shared keys MAIL_FROM, MAIL_REPLY_TO and MAIL_ENABLED belong to notifications/mail.py.
